description_en: Queries the detailed audio and video frame rates and bitrates of an RTMP live stream
description_zh: 查询RTMP协议直播流的详细音视频帧率码率
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-stream-detail-frame-rate-and-bit-rate-data --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name AppName --stream-name exampleStreamName --start-time 2017-12-21T08:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-22T08:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveStreamDetailFrameRateAndBitRateData

parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs. You can view the AppName on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.help_zh: 直播流所属应用名称。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the live stream. You can view the StreamName on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.help_zh: 直播流名称。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看StreamName
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en: The end time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC+8). If StartTime and EndTime are invalid or not specified, data from the last 1 hour is returned by default
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（北京时间，UTC+8）。 StartTime 和 EndTime 指定不合法，或者不指定 StartTime 和 EndTime 时，默认读取过去 1 小时的数据
parameters.name: end_time
